name: High-Sensitivity Vibration Switch
description: Like an earthquake detector! A spring contact shakes open when vibration or shock is detected.
realWorldAnalogy: Like an earthquake detector! A spring contact shakes open when vibration or shock is detected.
wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red) to 5V, GND (Dark Slate) to GND, and DO (Green) to digital pin 3.
commonMistakes: Leaving the sensor dangling freely without rigid mounting to the monitored chassis.
Missing rapid transient pulse events by polling too slowly in the sketch.

miniExperiment.title: Seismic Quake Alarm
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, DO to Pin 3.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Tapping the desk triggers 'VIBRATION DETECTED!' instantly in the Serial Monitor.
